paragraphs.source_en: “Where shall one place the mind? If the mind is placed on the movements of the enemy’s body, the mind will be taken by the movements of the enemy’s body. If the mind is placed on the fixed resolve to kill the enemy, the mind will be taken by that thought of killing the enemy. If the mind is placed on one’s own sword, the mind will be taken by one’s own sword.
